messages:
rachel-marketing: OK team — planning quick launch for MicroStarter OSS refapp + 10-min tutorial vids + benchmark blog. Need timeline + comms owners. Goal: blog + 2 webinars next Thu. Link to plan: https://docs.google.com/example

maya-devcontent: I can own the tutorial series (short vids + code sample). Can we aim for 3 x 5-min clips? Also need starter repo PR reviewed.

jon-eng: Happy to help on the repo + provide a lightweight perf script. Will post kernel flags and runbook.

sam-growth: I'll draft the launch post + email drip. Need hero benchmark numbers to call out (latency/cost). Can someone run baseline by EOD?

leo-data: I'll run microbench on Dedicated vs Hosted and share csv + chart. ETA 6 hrs.

rachel-marketing: Perfect. Draft messaging angle: "developer-first, production-grade inference in a tiny refapp" — short, practical, central CTA: try the starter repo.

maya-devcontent: For the vids & sample code, recommend these snippets:
```
# run example
pip install microstarter
microstarter start --model redwood-small --batch 4
```
Keep it copy-paste friendly.

jon-eng: Adding an example perf command:
```
python perf_runner.py --requests 1000 --seq 256 --quantized
```
I'll push perf_runner tonight.

sam-growth: Draft tweet thread idea:
1/ Quick look at MicroStarter — 5-min guide to shipping LLM features.
2/ Bench: Xms p95, Y tokens/s on Dedicated.
3/ Link to walkthrough + repo.
Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

maya-devcontent: Love it. Also propose a 20-min webinar: demo + Q&A. I'll host. Sam, can you own registration page + CTAs?

sam-growth: Yep. I'll set up GA + HubSpot form. Need event copy by tomorrow.

leo-data: Uploaded results: https://storage.redwood.ai/microstarter/bench-172945.csv — p95 numbers attached. Quick note: Hosted variability +/-12% on long seqs.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled release window Thu 15:00-16:00 UTC. Please confirm any production toggles.

rachel-marketing: OK confirm owners: Maya tutorials, Jon repo & perf script, Leo benches, Sam comms. Action items: Sam send draft by 09:00 tomorrow; Jon push perf_runner; Maya PR open for review; Leo final CSV + charts; I'll draft launch post skeleton.

jon-eng: Will open PR by 22:00 PST tonight. Tagging @maya-devcontent for review.

maya-devcontent: Great — will review first thing.

sam-growth: I'll spin up registration + basic landing and share link here when ready.

rachel-marketing: Thanks all — short standup 09:15 tomorrow if needed. :sparkles:
